docs: describe provider data-use terms

The default provider is the free Gemini tier, where Google may train on
prompts and human reviewers may read them, yet the docs only said that
the diff leaves the machine. Users had no way to compare providers on
training, retention and review without reading every terms page.

Add a data-use table to docs/providers.md with links to each provider's
terms, and a README privacy note that points to it and to the existing
file exclusions. Provider requests are unchanged.
